about_the_game:
The following content is included:

●Seikret Decoration: Purehorn Caparison

The beautiful horn decoration and classical design of this Seikret decoration create a pure atmosphere.

Enjoy the hunting life with your trusty companion equipped with special layered armor!

*You can apply Seikret decorations by selectinfg Edit Seikret Decorations from the Appearance Menu in your tent.
*This item changes the appearance of your seikret. It does not affect stats or abilities.
*This product is also available as part of a set.
*You may need to update to the latest version of the game to use this content.
